title: Vickers Wellington MF116
memorial_details: Large stone (possibly limestone), vaguely triangular with finished, vertical, front face, upon which is mounted a square, polished, black marble tablet. A Bomber Command crest in gold relief is displayed above the dedication, also in gold, relief, upper-case letters.
inscription: THIS MEMORIAL IS DEDICATED TO THE SIX AIRCREW OF/ WELLINGTON BOMBER MF 116/ 26 OTU, R.A.F. WING, OXFORDSHIRE/ WHO PERISHED WHHEN THEIR AIRCRAFT CRASHED/ ON THIS SPOT DURING THE NIGHT OF/14TH JANUARY 1945/ "THEIR NAMES LIVETH FOR EVERMORE"/ (names)
